original.templateName: AI App Builder — Request to Result
original.summary: An editable request-to-result app builder: a request appears on the left while a map, dashboard, feedback form and comparison table grow on the right, with skeleton states before content.
original.styleDescription: Field blue, interface ink, paper cream and orange accents; flat sans-serif UI cards on a 1920 × 1080 canvas.
original.reviewFocus: Keep the request panel visible as the cause while the result changes; show structure before data; share one task name across each request/result pair; update only the affected part when a new input arrives.
original.author: OpenMotion contributors
original.notes: Original repository-native recreation of the request-to-result motion language. Motion reference: Airtable "Create an app" (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/airtable_airtableai-nocodeai-activity-7343347865622036481-yJJC). No reference footage, screenshots, brand marks or third-party fonts are redistributed.

entry.conversionNotes: Repository-native editable HTML project with a source manifest. Not converted from a CMS package; no CMS upload or sourceArchive is required.
